points.description: Control plane responsibility stated precisely: it decides the routes/forwarding of packets (manages network graph, defines routes, updates switches' flow tables) OR handles unprocessed packets coming from the data plane; and it is logically centralized (may be physically distributed).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.125) if a correct responsibility is given but without mention of logical centralization/flow-table control, or vice versa.

points.description: Data plane responsibility stated precisely: it is responsible for packet forwarding; switches just execute actions according to their flow tables as decided by the control plane.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.125) if only 'forwards packets' is stated without that switches follow flow tables set by the control plane.

points.description: First controller task named correctly and specifically, from the model list (e.g. configuring forwarding/flow tables, injecting packets, handling packet-in events, collecting traffic statistics, topology discovery, device inventory, northbound/southbound interfaces, implementing the control plane).
Second, different controller task named correctly and specifically, from the model list.

rubric.notes: Full marks need a precise control plane responsibility, a precise data plane responsibility (forwarding per flow tables), and two distinct, correct controller tasks from the model list. Vague statements like 'controls the network' earn nothing for that point. A wrong statement within a point (e.g. data plane makes routing decisions) cancels that point; a wrong extra controller task cancels its point. Repeating the same task twice earns only one point.
